context.transcript:
Hello.
I've called this meeting of the software development team to share some good news.
We've already exceeded our sales projections for the new software, and I'd like to thank you all for the late nights and weekends you spent working to design such a great product.
So the management has decided to give you all a bonus, which will be included in your next paycheck.
Thanks again for your exceptional work.
context.transcript_translation:
您好。
我召集这次软件开发团队会议是为了分享一些好消息。
我们已经超出了新软件的销售预测，我想感谢大家为了设计出如此优秀的产品而熬夜和周末付出的努力。
所以管理层决定给大家发奖金，这笔钱将包含在你们下一次工资单里。
再次感谢大家的出色工作。
